sourceTitle: Horse-Shoe Robinson: A Tale of the Tory Ascendency
description: "Horse-Shoe Robinson: A Tale of the Tory Ascendency" by John Pendleton Kennedy is a novel published in 1835. This historical romance of the American Revolution unfolds across the western mountains of the Carolinas and Virginia, building toward the dramatic Battle of Kings Mountain.
